name: mcp-spreadsheet
description: Open, inspect, query, edit and convert xlsx and csv files locally from your AI assistant

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: sheet_info
tools.description: Open an xlsx or csv file and describe it: sheet names, size, guessed header row, per-column type, sample values and empty counts. Start here before reading or querying.

tools.name: sheet_read
tools.description: Read rows from a sheet as a text table, JSON records or CSV. Use limit/offset to page through big files, or range for an A1 block like B2:F40.

tools.name: sheet_query
tools.description: Filter, pick columns and sort rows without writing any code. where uses a small safe expression language: comparisons = != > >= < <= plus contains / startswith / endswith, combined with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses. Column names with spaces go in brackets: [Unit Price] > 10 AND [Region] contains "north". Strings use single or double quotes.

tools.name: sheet_stats
tools.description: Per-column count, empty count, distinct values, min, max, sum, mean and median. Numbers are parsed from currency and percent text too.

tools.name: sheet_find
tools.description: Search every cell for text (case insensitive) and return cell addresses with a preview of the row it is on.

tools.name: sheet_write
tools.description: Write rows to a spreadsheet. rows may be objects (keys become headers) or arrays (first array is the header row). mode new_file writes a brand new file and refuses to clobber an existing one; append adds the rows under the existing data; overwrite replaces the file contents. Format follows the extension of out_path (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv, .json).

tools.name: sheet_add_column
tools.description: Add a computed column and save the result to a NEW file (the source is never modified unless out_path points at it). formula uses the same expression language as sheet_query over the columns of each row, e.g. "[Qty] * [Unit Price]" or '[Country] = "PL"'. Alternatively pass values, one per data row.

tools.name: sheet_convert
tools.description: Convert a sheet to csv, xlsx or json. Writes a new file next to the source unless out_path is given.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
